idPartners.title: Backend Developer (internship)
points: Cut ~3 hours of daily manual work for the sales team with a bidirectional Google Sheets ↔ Pipedrive CRM integration (client Aguartec, aquaculture sector).
Explored the Pipedrive REST API endpoints with Postman and automated product, price and deal sync with Google Apps Script, removing manual data entry.
Ensured data integrity during concurrent updates with validation and error handling.

henryTA.title: Student Teaching Assistant
points: Helped students from later cohorts solve problems and debug code in one-on-one and group sessions.
Explained concepts such as React components, Node.js middlewares and data modeling with Sequelize and MongoDB.

hospitality.title: Hospitality & customer service
points: My projects (bookings, shifts, cash control) solve problems I lived first-hand in 10 years of hospitality.

cashRegisterSystem.name: Cash Register MVP
cashRegisterSystem.description: Cash-control system for small businesses. Cash opening/closing as atomic operations with Prisma, financial reports with SQL aggregations and optimistic state on the frontend with Zustand.

shiftManagementSystem.name: Shift Management System
shiftManagementSystem.description: Multi-tenant B2B booking SaaS in production. 3-role RBAC (NestJS Guards), JWT with refresh tokens and conflict detection with Prisma atomic transactions. ~220 Jest tests (unit + e2e against real PostgreSQL), GitHub Actions CI, a 24-issue security audit and a Swagger-documented API.

countriesInfoApp.name: Countries Info App
countriesInfoApp.description: Express.js backend as proxy/aggregator for external APIs (Nager.Date, CountriesNow) with fallback system for service failures. Interactive visualization of demographic data for 200+ countries with Chart.js and efficient pagination.

about.description: Junior backend developer (NestJS · TypeScript · PostgreSQL), currently studying a Higher Vocational Diploma in Cross-Platform Application Development (DAM) at ILERNA and available for internships in Bizkaia (Spain) or remote. During my internship at IdPartners I built a bidirectional Google Sheets ↔ Pipedrive CRM integration that removed ~3 hours of daily manual work for the sales team of an aquaculture client. My main project, Shift Management, is a multi-tenant booking SaaS in production with RBAC, JWT refresh tokens, ~220 tests, GitHub Actions CI and a 24-issue security audit. I come from ~10 years in hospitality: my projects solve problems I lived first-hand.
